codeQuality.summary: The file contains 1 CRITICAL XSS vulnerability in the highlight() function that allows arbitrary HTML injection. There are multiple HIGH severity issues including incorrect string replacement logic and outdated JavaScript patterns using 'var' instead of const/let. The code uses legacy ES5 patterns (var, for loops, indexOf) throughout instead of modern ES6+ features (const/let, array methods, includes). Performance issues include redundant toLowerCase() calls in loops and inefficient array operations. The code lacks input validation which creates multiple bug risks. Modernizing to ES6+, fixing the XSS vulnerability, and adding proper input validation are critical improvements needed.

refactorings.summary: The src/search.js file has significant opportunities for modernization and improvement. Key findings: (1) Replace all 'var' declarations with 'const/let' for better scoping and safety; (2) Modernize loops with array methods (filter, map, some, forEach) for cleaner, more functional code; (3) Extract repeated logic into helper functions (matchesTodo, filterByDoneStatus, tokenizeQuery) to reduce duplication and improve testability; (4) Fix critical XSS vulnerability in highlight function by properly escaping HTML; (5) Use strict equality (===) instead of loose equality (==); (6) Apply optional chaining for safer property access. These changes would transform the code from ES5 style to modern ES6+ with functional patterns, significantly improving readability, safety, and maintainability while reducing the codebase size by ~20 lines through more concise expressions.

recommendations.description: Fix XSS vulnerability in highlight() function immediately. User input is directly inserted into HTML without sanitization, allowing script injection attacks. Use DOM API methods or a sanitization library.

Add comprehensive test coverage for search.js. The file is completely untested (0% coverage) despite containing critical functionality and a security vulnerability. Create src/search.test.js with tests for all 4 exported functions.

Modernize to ES6+ syntax by replacing all 'var' with 'const/let', using strict equality (===), and replacing for loops with array methods (filter, map, some). This improves safety, readability, and follows modern JavaScript best practices.

Fix highlight() function bugs: (1) replace() only highlights first occurrence of each term, (2) case-sensitive replacement doesn't match case-insensitive search behavior. Use regex with global and case-insensitive flags.

Extract helper functions (matchesTodo, filterByDoneStatus, tokenizeQuery) to reduce code duplication, improve testability, and separate concerns. This will reduce complexity and make the codebase more maintainable.
Add input validation for function parameters. Check that query is a string, results is an array, and todo.title exists before processing. This prevents runtime errors from malformed inputs.
Add JSDoc comments to all exported functions documenting parameters, return types, and behavior. This improves code maintainability and developer experience.
